chapters.title: Where does a data center's water go?
chapters.hook: One big data center can use up tens of millions of gallons of water a year. Where does it all go?

chapters.title: Why don't they just reuse the water?
chapters.hook: A data center's cooling tower reuses its water several times, so why does it still drain some away?

chapters.title: Why not release it into a river?
chapters.hook: When a data center drains water from its cooling towers, why not just pipe it into the nearest river?

chapters.title: Why not cool it without water?
chapters.hook: A data center can be cooled with no cooling water at all, so why doesn't every data center do that?
